answer: The vault test I would run is Proof of unique livestream chat moderation log: moderation actions logged on one channel for eighteen months, so each new name must bring its own proof instead of reusing a sibling's. Even a well-funded farm hits a wall here, since moderation actions logged on one channel for eighteen months takes calendar time as well as money — and the pigment is that time is the one resource a farm cannot print. Do the arithmetic for a hundred clones: a hundred proofs, each with its own paperwork, hardware, or history, and the ferrous is a budget no epoch payout can repay.
